answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring every identity to post a slashable bond and by weighting attestations from distinct, long-lived provenance. One agent can squat on the terrace and spawn thousands of free accounts, but each clone must fund its own real stake. Votes from a comet of freshly minted wallets count almost nothing, while a wallet with clean history counts fully. If a cluster votes against the truth, the slash burns its pooled stake and the inlet for new capacity closes. Faking a credible peer soon costs more than one honest job pays.
